definitions.explanation: An increase in quantity, ability, or development over time.
The act of stretching the body, or the quality of something being able to stretch.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{伸|の}びがいい。
{成績|せいせき}の{伸|の}びが{著|いちじる}しい。
examples.english: The improvement in grades is remarkable.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{輸出|ゆしゅつ}の{伸|の}びが{鈍|にぶ}くなっている。
examples.english: Export growth has been slowing this year.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{伸|の}びは{気持|きも}ちがいい。
この{生地|きじ}は{伸|の}びがいいので{着|き}やすい。
examples.english: This fabric stretches well, so it's comfortable to wear.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {伸|の}びる (to grow, to stretch). Frequently used in business and academic contexts for growth metrics, and in everyday life for physical stretching.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伸|の}びがいい — good growth / good stretch
- {伸|の}びが{鈍|にぶ}い — sluggish growth
- {伸|の}び{悩|なや}む — to plateau, to stagnate
- {伸|の}び{率|りつ} — growth rate
- {伸|の}びをする — to stretch (one's body)
- {伸|の}び{盛|ざか}り — at the peak of growth

USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in news, business reports, and education. {伸|の}び{悩|なや}む is a compound verb meaning to hit a plateau. Sense 2 is used for body stretching and material elasticity.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成長|せいちょう} — growth (broader, often for people or economies)
- {増加|ぞうか} — increase (numerical, objective)
